policy: Working-tree snapshot; original repositories unchanged. Imported packages retain existing namespaces.

modules.selection: Only upstream active auth/billing Kotlin sources and three compiled unit test files. No ads, Analytics, DevHub, original UI/resources or host product configuration.

integrationAdjustments: All core modules use local source dependencies and centralized toolchain.
Agora source dependency 4.7.0 unavailable on Maven Central; integrated published 4.6.4.
Metadata DTO/model packages decoupled from photo database; business DAO/repository/schema migration tests stay in source App.
NAS advanced gate and notification routing are host configured.
Auth, FCM, Credential Manager, Firebase and billing are separate optional modules.
Billing offline duration is host configurable; seven divergent copies not claimed merged.
Roof-specific report-template policy omitted from generic OpenXML writer.
Router Gradle plugin registers lazy dependencies before KSP evaluation; published consumer compiles generated route tables.
Metadata raster tests use migrated fixture paths; headless transfer notifications omit click actions instead of failing workers; advanced access tests inject host policy.
